Parliamentary panel hears officials on Corporate Laws Amendment Bill

A parliamentary committee is reviewing the Corporate Laws Amendment Bill. Officials from the Finance Ministry and the National Financial Reporting Authority (NFRA) have presented their views to the panel. This process is part of the legislative procedure for amending corporate laws.
